record.question: He walked off without _________ ceremony.
record.explanation: Answer B: further. The idiom is “without further ceremony” (B). Independent check: “Further ceremony” means additional ceremony; “further” is the correct adjective before the uncountable noun. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/far-farther-farthest-or-further-furthest. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
